title: אקדח הוועדה

spec.palette: designed ramps, at most 5 steps each: enamel 5, redtape 4, brass 3, steel 3, wood 3, ivory 2, mark 1

source: hand-placed pixels at 0 deg, every column (art/chars/weapons/w4/tools/tape_px.py); rows turned RotSprite-style (Scale2x x3, nearest), stray pixels out, the mark stamped upright after the turn, a 1 px outline
character:
WHO: a committee squeezed into a gun: an office-green enamel casing with a brass nameplate, a fat roll of RED TAPE where
       a drum magazine would be, a pile of forms and a desk bell on its back, and at the front a little desk with an
       inset ink pad over which a RUBBER STAMP stands on a spring like a jack-in-the-box. It approves things at people.
  IDLE: nobody touches it and it still works: the stamp bobs and taps the air as if signing, a form slides half out
        over the desk and back in, unsigned. FIRE: the roll spins, red tape lashes out of the cutter, then the stamp
        comes down on the form (tick 14), the bell dings, and the approved form goes back in the drawer.
cell_note: a bigger cell than the contract's 64: it holds the weapon at every angle with its moving parts thrown out and the toss

equip.note: 18 ticks: it comes up and forward from the hip, nose low (the stamp lags behind on its spring, the tag trails), overshoots, and the stamp slams its own ink pad at tick 8 to ink itself, pops, wobbles, stands

idle.note: 146 ticks: nobody touches it: the stamp bobs and taps the air twice, signs with a little wiggle, stands; then a form slides half out over the desk, the stamp perks up to read it, and it slides back in

fire.note: 24 ticks = the cooldown, so it chains. Tick 0 the tape leaves like a spear and the roll spins (the stamp ducks, the whole gun gives a pixel); 2 the ribbon whips; 6 the cutter bites; 8 a form slides out under the stamp, which winds up on its spring; 14 THE STAMP: down on the form, the bell dings, ink flies, the gun nods; then the pop, two wobbles while the approved form goes back in the drawer

empty.note: 12 ticks: the click: the roll is a bare cardboard core with one scrap of tape, the stamp droops; a shake; at 6 he tosses it away in front of him (three tumbling frames, nose down, the tag trailing)

catch.note: the hand-off from the unarmed catch (catch.json has the body's frames): it lands in his hands, the stamp bounces from the jolt, the reveal from the last frame

aim_note: a frame's aim = degrees the weapon turns from its rest (the idle's first frame is 0), added to the body's aim; kick = [px along the barrel (negative = back), px up, degrees up]
mark: the made-in-Israel mark as a HANGING TAG (a slim weapon: no calm 13 x 13 place, and the roll turns): an ivory luggage tag, 11 x 13, with the blue interlaced outline star 9 x 9, on a short blue-and-white cord from the brass swivel under the desk; it hangs with gravity, upright and whole, in every angle row, and swings by whole pixels with the shot, the stamp's blow and the toss
mark_rect_note: per angle row, per column: [x, y, w, h] of the mark in the cell (the tag with its line, or the 11 x 11 roundel) and mark_star = the top-left pixel of the 9 x 9 star; atlas_mark.png holds the mark alone in the same layout

events.draw: the gun comes up from the hip (arsenal.json equip 0)
events.stamp_pad: the stamp slams its ink pad (equip 8): a wet thud
events.ready: the act is over on this frame's last tick: can fire
events.anticipation: the 1-tick squash, on the shot's own tick (fire 0)
events.shot: the tape leaves the cutter (fire 0): FX and the projectile on this frame, at `muzzle`
events.unroll: the roll spins up, the ribbon whips (fire 2)
events.stamp: THE STAMP comes down on the form (fire 14): thud, the bell's ding, ink
events.click: the trigger on a bare core (empty 0)
events.toss: the spent gun leaves his hand (empty 6)
events.reveal: RENDER fires the reveal from this pose

normal_note: by plane: every colour paints one plane of the weapon (top, front, underside ...), turned with the row; silhouette pixels face out along the edge; the upright mark faces the viewer

cells: the form crumpled on the floor
sprites.anchor: the cell's TOP-left at `at` (frame px; the sprite stands on the cell's bottom, centred)

catch.note: the weapon's side of the unarmed set's catch, on the same ticks and hand points as the shotgun's catch.json (the body is one builder's): frames 0-2 it comes down, 3 the catch (its grip lands on the hand), 3-4 what carried it lets go, 5-6 in the hands, 7-9 held up behind his head (layer back), the reveal from 9. Its carrier is the form: on the catch it folds, then lies crumpled.
